'''Dindau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Dindau was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Daring (transport)|''Daring'']] when it participated in the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the exploration of the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. Also aboard the ''Daring'' was his crew: his first mate [[Kohlbacca]], a female albino [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]; and [[Herren]], a human who was the ship's gunner and engineer. However, the ship collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and was severely damaged. With the life support systems failing, Dindau sent at a distress call to any nearby ships. It was picked up by the ''[[Neeva-Beelo]]'' and its crew, the famous [[Heroes of Cularin]], attempted to rescue Dindau and his crew before it was too late.
